features.title: sdd chat — interactive conversation mode
acceptance_criteria: sdd chat launches persistent multi-turn session
User types responses without re-running sdd
quit exits cleanly and saves session
History preserved across exchanges within session

features.title: File reading — --file flag
acceptance_criteria: sdd --file path.txt 'analyze this' works
File content injected into agent prompt
Supports .txt .md .js .json .py .sh
File too large produces clear error

features.title: sdd skills — AI-described skill list
acceptance_criteria: sdd skills lists all skills with human-readable descriptions
Each skill shows trigger keywords and current status
Output is formatted and scannable

features.title: Autocomplete + UX improvements
acceptance_criteria: Tab autocomplete works for sdd commands
Welcome banner on sdd with no args
sdd help is formatted with columns

features.title: Verified RAG researcher
acceptance_criteria: Researcher cross-verifies claims against 2+ sources
Confidence score on factual claims
Sources cited in output
Hallucination rate measurably reduced

features.title: Multi-language support
acceptance_criteria: Language detected from user input or set via config
All agents respond in configured language
sdd config language es|fr|pt|en works
Mentor teaches in user's language

features.title: Harness foundation — constitution.md, featurelist.json, history.md
acceptance_criteria: constitution.md exists with 7 rule sections
featurelist.json exists with all F35-F51 entries
history.md exists with structured log entries
verify.sh checks for all three files and passes

features.title: Auto-update protocol + start.sh calibration
acceptance_criteria: start.sh verifies constitution.md, SPEC.md, CAPABILITIES.md exist before launch
start.sh checks Node.js, git, Ollama status
backup.sh includes SPEC.md and CAPABILITIES.md in staged files
sdd backup command triggers full protocol

features.title: skills/library/ — markdown skill files
acceptance_criteria: skills/library/ directory exists
At least 6 skill files: intent-parser, spec-clarifier, guardian-angel, git-delivery, context-compaction, self-audit
Each skill file has: trigger, instructions, output schema, constraints, failure behavior
skills/router.js loads full skill content dynamically

features.title: Intent parser — phi4-mini JSON normalization
acceptance_criteria: Runs only on tasks >15 words or no clear keyword match
Output is valid JSON: task_type, complexity, key_requirements, suggested_model
Does not run on simple short tasks
Uses phi4-mini or Groq — independent from main Gemini quota

features.title: Per-model skill files + task-aware local router
acceptance_criteria: OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=1 enforced
coding → qwen2.5-coder:7b
code review → deepseek-coder:6.7b
general reasoning → qwen2.5:7b
research/writing → gemma3:4b
intent parsing → phi4-mini
Online cascade triggers only on local model failure or --online flag

features.title: Per-model context budget
acceptance_criteria: Each model has max_prompt_tokens in adapter.json
Prompt measured before every engine call
Compression triggers in order: memory → skill context → prior agent output
No model receives prompt over its budget

features.title: Spec-clarifier + guardian-angel skills
acceptance_criteria: Spec-clarifier runs before negotiator on complex tasks
Lists all non-obvious assumptions for user confirmation
Guardian-angel audits output against constitution.md before saving
Guardian-angel blocks save on violation with specific rule cited

features.title: sdd session-end command
acceptance_criteria: sdd session-end command exists
Generates structured summary: tasks completed, decisions, issues
Appends to history.md in standard format
Calls backup.sh automatically

features.title: Semantic memory retrieval — nomic-embed-text
acceptance_criteria: nomic-embed-text running via Ollama
Top-5 semantically relevant memory entries retrieved per task
Memory injection reduced from full file to targeted entries
Token reduction >80% vs flat file injection

acceptance_criteria: sdd audit 'capability' searches CAPABILITIES.md
Checks if responsible files exist on disk
Reports status from featurelist.json
